subject: Error when converting a dataframe to telemetry object

messages.author: c6e5a5622337843b
messages.subject: Error when converting a dataframe to telemetry object
parts:
Hallo all,

My data frame was being converted to a telemetry object, just fine when using an earlier version of ctmm package. However, upon updating to the latest version: I am now receiving the error I have pasted below. Does anyone have an idea what could be happening?
I will appreciate your assistance.

Thanks,
Gladys.

Error: .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'units', details: call: NULL error: no database found!

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Error when converting a dataframe to telemetry object
parts:
Hi Gladys,

Whenever I have seen database errors, it was because the installation silently failed, and the solution was to remove the package, restart R, and install the package anew.

Best,
Chris
